items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: I had Buddy Childers and Ralph Pena Pinaud, Art Anton and Bob Harrington

ctx.x: I read several accounts of your differences with [Beldon Cattleman] in Las Vegas, and I love the story. Tell it for me, will you?

Well, we were booked in there. This was a quintet. I had Buddy Childers and Ralph Pena Pinaud, Art Anton and Bob Harrington, and we were supposed to play in the lounge, you know. So the contract says 11:00 to 4:00, and we go up there, we play there a few days, and Beldon comes over to me and says, "We're changing the hours. You're going to play from 12:00 to 6:00." I said, "No, we're not going to change any hours." I said, "You're a businessman and I'm sure you read the contract before you signed it. I did." I…
and we'd play choruses on that, and we went the whole scale, you know. And then at 12:00 o'clock we'd turn the lights on. But then we'd quit at 4:00.
